key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Defines whether the application follows the system color scheme or forces a light or dark appearance.

key.name: sidebar-visible
key.description: Defines whether the sidebar is visible when the application starts.

key.name: default-view-mode
key.description: Defines the default view mode used when opening a PDF document.

key.name: default-zoom
key.description: Defines the default zoom level when manual zoom mode is selected.
